description: Frontiers' journal class FrontiersinHarvard.cls v2.6 (2016/11/10, based on bioinfo.cls) with Frontiers-Harvard.bst, from Frontiers_LaTeX_Templates.zip (www.frontiersin.org/design/zip/, linked from frontiersin.org/guidelines/author-guidelines; files dated 2023-09-20). The current template (frontiers.tex l.14) uses FrontiersinHarvard for author-date journals; FrontiersinVancouver.cls (numbered) differs only in its date and spacing, and frontiersSCNS.cls is no longer in the kit. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror; no licence (kept private). utf8 is the template's option, passed to inputenc (under XeTeX inputenc only warns). The class loads inputenc, crop, graphicx, amsmath, array, color, amssymb, flushend, stfloats, amsthm, chngpage, times, datetime and epstopdf (l.32) and natbib (l.863), and sets headings in phv. The preamble repeats the template's title-block macros, which the class's \maketitle prints without defining them (l.496-504): \keyFont, \firstAuthorLast, \Authors, \Address, \corrAuthor and \corrEmail (frontiers.tex l.28-38). The class's \maketitle includes ./logo1.eps (l.486), shipped from the same zip. Two lines make room for packages the class does not expect: \if@titlepage, which FrontiersinHarvard.cls does not define and abstract.sty tests (without it, 'Undefined control sequence' at \if@titlepage), and article's description environment and \descriptionlabel, which the class lacks and enumitem changes (without it, 'Environment description undefined'). Probe run of the batch 3 optional lines: 6 and 1 errors without the lines, 0 with them; frontiers' own three page-head box warnings in every case. The last line starts the running heads and feet with \hsize set to \textwidth: each page put an overfull box 261pt too wide in the log from them (probe run 41996846655: the 14 boxes 261.0pt too wide gone, no new error, the same pages and sentinels; the control document unchanged).
